content: {"episode_id":"ep-05081","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"The patient has recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness that are poorly correlated with standard 24-hour Holter monitoring results, with a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia. The clinical indication note states that prolonged cardiac event monitoring is indicated to capture intermittent symptomatic episodes and guide further rhythm management. We request reconsideration of the CO-97 denial for CPT 93271 based on this documented clinical indication; the payer letter identifies bundling into another covered procedure as the reason for denial."}
